positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on trading platform for institutional and retail spot and derivatives crypto trading. Focus in trade execution, institutional integration and scaling the platform. Backend distributed systems development in gRPC, Go, Postgres, Kafka.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Backend API and distributed systems development in Node, Elixir and Go. Founding member of the print and mail services team. Primary author and lead maintainer of the Elixir library.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Full stack Rails development with emphasis on product/front-end engineering. Worked on the homepage UX overhaul (React), 2014 Goodreads Choice Awards and Audible sample button on book pages.

positions.title: Staff Photographer
positions.description: Photographed events and news stories relating to Cornell on a weekly basis.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked in the Platform Excellence team for the E-Commerce Platform. Migrated an infrastructure risk auditing tool to a distributed task scheduling service using AWS SWF.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
Conducted research dealing with evolutionary algorithms (evolving existing 3D objects
using CPPN’s and NEAT, seen on endlessforms.com).
Past research dealt with brain-computer interfaces and machine learning.

positions.title: Web Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Full Rails stack development on an internal project management/bug tracking tool. Re-launched and maintained The World Clock Project.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: Worked with the Analytics and Business Intelligence team on data mining and analytics projects on NYSE infrastructure data.

positions.title: Videographer
positions.description:
• Filmed, edited, and oversaw production of a 30 minute "Senior Video" for the School of Mechanical Engineering at Cornell University.

• Worked with prosumer grade equipment (Canon XL1s, Lowel light kit, Sennheiser ME66) and professional-level software (Adobe Creative Suite 5)

company.name: Sibley School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
